title: Airtable record is missing a field entirely when the checkbox is false or the cell is empty
symptoms: record.fields.Done is undefined instead of false
TypeError reading a property of undefined for an empty linked record field
Schema inferred from API rows is missing columns
cause: List and get responses leave out any field whose value counts as empty, including empty strings, empty arrays and false. An unchecked checkbox and a deleted field look identical in the response.
fix: Default every field you read, and get the real column list from the base schema endpoint instead of from returned rows.
apply:
const done = record.fields["Done"] ?? false;
const tags = record.fields["Tags"] ?? [];
affected: Airtable Web API, all record read endpoints, as of 2026-10
